subject: spanish
title: Opinions on Hobbies
welcome_lead: Say what you like, love or hate doing.
meta_desc: KS3 Spanish: opinions, gustar, me encanta.

walkthroughs.body_html: Me gusta + singular thing or verb. 'Me gusta el futbol'. 'Me gusta leer'. With plural: me gustan. 'Me gustan los libros'.
Me encanta = I love it. Stronger than gustar. 'Me encanta la musica' = 'I love music'.
'Mi deporte favorito es el futbol' = 'My favourite sport is football'. Favorito/favorita changes with gender.
